summary: Burn enemies to build Heat. Heat damages you each turn and can fuel your next Fire hit.

fields.Base value: 70 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Cinders: Burn an enemy to gain 2 turns of Heat. Burning multiple enemies with one action still grants just 2 turns.
fields.Heat: Take 1d4 Fire damage each turn. Heat stacks to a maximum of 7 turns.
fields.Heat Convergence: Toggle on to spend all remaining Heat when you next deal Fire damage, adding 1 Fire damage per remaining turn. A multi-hit spell gains the bonus on the first hit. An area spell gains it against all affected targets.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
